_note: English is the source of truth. es.json is generated from this at build time (Task 12). Keys marked below are emitted by evaluate() (nextStepKey / messageKey) and are frozen as part of the Task 1 contract. UI-only keys are owned by the UI coder.
step.heap.next_step: Apply for fuel assistance (HEAP) through your local agency.
step.discount.next_step: Ask your utility to put you on the income-eligible discount rate.
step.amp.next_step: Ask your utility about the Arrearage Management Program to lower past-due debt.
step.mass_save.next_step: Ask about no-cost Mass Save energy upgrades for income-eligible homes.
discount.mlp.ask_light_plant: Your community has a municipal light plant. Ask them what discount and debt help they offer.
discount.unknown.check_bill: Check your bill or call your utility to find out who provides your service.
billcheck.on_standard_rate: You may be on the standard rate when you could get a discount. You may be owed money. Contact your HEAP agency or legal aid.
error.data_unavailable: This information is not available right now. Please call the Heatline at 1-800-632-8175.
protect.moratorium.script: Ask the utility for winter protection, and ask for the financial hardship form. Return it within 7 days.
protect.heap_presumption.script: Call to confirm you are protected, and apply for HEAP before January 1.
protect.infant.script: Tell the utility a child under 12 months lives with you. You can start by phone, then send proof within 7 days.
protect.illness.script: Ask a doctor or nurse to call the utility about the serious illness, then send the certificate within 7 days.
protect.elderly_minor.script: Tell the utility all adults are 65 or older and a child lives with you, and ask for protection.
protect.all_65.script: Tell the utility everyone in the home is 65 or older. They cannot shut off service without approval from the state.
abovecliff.good_neighbor.next_step: Call 2-1-1 or the Heatline to reach your local Salvation Army about the Good Neighbor Energy Fund.
abovecliff.oil_relief.next_step: If you heat with oil, ask about Middle-Income Heating Oil Relief. Applications open December 2026.
